benefits.name: United travel credit
benefits.notes: $100 United TravelBank cash after $10,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: United Hotels credit
benefits.notes: $50 statement credit on each of the first two prepaid United Hotels stays per cardmember year.

benefits.name: Rideshare credit
benefits.notes: Up to $5/month in statement credits on rideshare purchases ($60/yr); opt in every calendar year.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: $10 credit in your Instacart account each month with an active Instacart+ membership (3 months free, then 25% off).

benefits.name: Avis / Budget credit
benefits.notes: Paid as United TravelBank cash: $25 on each of the first two Avis/Budget rentals booked via mileageplustravel.united.com per cardmember year.

benefits.name: JSX credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit on flights booked directly with JSX; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: United Club passes
benefits.notes: Two United Club one-time passes each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Free checked bag
benefits.notes: First standard checked bag free for the primary cardmember and one companion on the same reservation (United/United Express-operated flights; ticket bought with the card, MileagePlus number on the reservation).

benefits.name: Spend award flight discount
benefits.notes: 10,000-mile award flight discount after $20,000 in purchases in a calendar year (one per year); expires 12 months after issue.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order while enrolled in DashPass via the card, through 12/31/2027. DoorDash lists every Chase co-brand (except Amazon, Instacart, DoorDash cards) as eligible with the promo "monthly or quarterly" by card; United's own card pages don't mention DashPass, so cadence is unconfirmed (quarterly assumed — monthly is likely if DashPass was first activated 9/1/2026 or later).
